albedo.label: Surface albedo
albedo.source: MODIS MCD43 C6.1 white-sky shortwave albedo, NASA GIBS layer MODIS_Combined_L3_White_Sky_Albedo_Daily, 2023
albedo.licence: NASA EOSDIS open data, no restrictions
albedo.note: median of the months within 0.10 of the darkest month (snow-free part of the year); 0.05 deg pixels

ndvi_max.label: Highest monthly NDVI
ndvi_max.source: MODIS MOD13C2 C6.1 monthly NDVI, NASA GIBS layer MODIS_Terra_L3_NDVI_Monthly, 2023
ndvi_max.licence: NASA EOSDIS open data, no restrictions
ndvi_max.note: months with NDVI <= 0, snow, water or no data are not measured; 0.05 deg pixels

ndvi_mean.label: Mean monthly NDVI
ndvi_mean.source: MODIS MOD13C2 C6.1 monthly NDVI, NASA GIBS layer MODIS_Terra_L3_NDVI_Monthly, 2023
ndvi_mean.licence: NASA EOSDIS open data, no restrictions
ndvi_mean.note: mean of the months with NDVI > 0

aridity.label: Aridity index (P / PET)
aridity.source: NASA POWER climatology 2001-2025 (MERRA-2): PRECTOTCORR, T2M, T2M_RANGE, TOA_SW_DWN; Hargreaves PET
aridity.note: UNEP classes: hyper-arid < 0.05, arid < 0.20, semi-arid < 0.50; 0.5 x 0.625 deg cell
